scope: Actual raw and HDR color-only OIDN pixels for hero, side, top at 640x640; still-frame only.

findings.observation: Upper stream remains visibly continuous in all three views and connects to a supported feed source.
The candidate-001 broad black band is removed. Top view establishes a connected stream/free surface.
findings.caveat: Uniform lower side-view tone is not alone evidence of opaque liquid; the studio background is largely featureless.

findings.observation: Broad bent wall highlights and a rounded/lens-like apparent free surface remain. Smooth-normal interpolation across long tapered-wall faces may contribute; this is a source-based hypothesis, not a proven root cause.
findings.acceptance_check: Straight vessel walls have coherent reflection bands while retaining believable rim/base bevels; the free surface remains clearly bounded by the vessel.

findings.observation: The impact junction has a bright rounded nub, especially in hero. A hidden stream cap/duplicate interface may contribute; this is a hypothesis.
findings.acceptance_check: Stream meets the receiving surface continuously without an isolated bead/cap appearance or implausible intersection.

recommendation: Use the final allowed candidate for wall support rings and a live Boolean stream/fill union, holding cameras, lighting, spec, seed, samples and display fixed. Record evaluated topology changes, preserve shape-key inputs, and do not claim equivalent GLB optics or final animation acceptance.
reference_comparison: Qualitative REF-01/REF-02 stream continuity and connected-impact cues are now substantially better. Different vessel/background prevent exact-match or material-calibration conclusions.
raw_vs_denoised: OIDN removes grain but softens fine surface detail; raw evidence is retained.
